items.passageEn: Long ago, there was a king. His favorite thing was fishing. Every day, he went fishing in a big pool in his beautiful garden. One day, his daughter said, "Let's have some fun! Let's dance!" The king danced with her, and everyone laughed.
items.passageZh: 很久以前，有一位國王。他最喜歡的事是釣魚，每天都在他美麗花園裡的大水池釣魚。有一天，他的女兒說：「我們來玩點有趣的吧！我們來跳舞！」國王和她一起跳舞，大家都笑了。

questions.questionZh: 國王的女兒提議做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們週末去游泳池游泳吧。
referenceEn: Let's swim in the pool this weekend.
Let's go to the pool this weekend.
rubricZh: 「在游泳池」可用 in the pool、at the pool；「去游泳池」用 go to the pool

items.promptZh: 孩子們正在公園裡跳舞。
referenceEn: The children are dancing in the park.
The kids are dancing in the park.
rubricZh: 「正在跳舞」用現在進行式（例如 are dancing）
「孩子們」可寫，例如 children、kids 等
